About this Event

🦃 FRIENDS GIVING – THANKSGIVING SPECIAL 🍂

Presented by BNJ (Bollywood in NJ) & MAD ENTERTAINMENTSThanksgiving weekend is all about good friends, great vibes, and unforgettable memories! This year, we're bringing everyone together for an extraordinary night of music, dancing, and celebration at THE FACTORY RESTAURANT & LOUNGE!
Get ready for FRIENDS GIVING, a high-energy Bollywood party featuring the incredible DJ RAKESH USA, taking over the decks with an electrifying mix of Bollywood chartbusters, Tollywood favorites, Punjabi hits, and your favorite club anthems.
Whether you're coming with your squad, meeting new people, or simply looking for the perfect Thanksgiving weekend celebration, this is where the party begins!
